Package dayplanner

Class Activity

java.lang.Object
dayplanner.Activity
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Activity>
Direct Known Subclasses:
HomeActivity, OtherActivity, SchoolActivity
public class Activity extends Object implements Comparable<Activity>

Represents a scheduled activity with a title, start time, end time, and optional comment.

Serves as the base class for HomeActivity, SchoolActivity, and OtherActivity.

The class stores its Time references directly and does not enforce that the end follows the start; callers creating activities directly should validate that rule themselves. For example: 

 Time start = new Time(2026, 10, 20, 14, 30);
 Time end = new Time(2026, 10, 20, 16, 30);
 Activity lab = new SchoolActivity("CIS 2430 Lab", start, end, "Bring laptop");

    • Activity

      public Activity(String title, Time startTime, Time endTime, String comment)

      Constructs an Activity with a title, start time, end time, and comment.

      A null or blank comment is ignored, leaving the comment unset.

      Parameters:

      comment - The activity comment.

    • Activity

      public Activity(String ras)

      Constructs an Activity from a RAS (Readable Activity Serial) string. Tokens are parsed in the following order:

      1. class name (ignored),
      2. title,
      3. start time,
      4. end time,
      5. comment (NIL is treated as no comment).

      Missing or empty fields retain defaults; malformed time fields may likewise leave their defaults in place. This is a parser intended for data loading.

      Parameters:
      ras - RAS entry, such as <HomeActivity,Laundry,2026/10/20 09:00,2026/10/20 10:00,NIL>.

    • toRAS

      public String toRAS()

      Encodes this activity into RAS (Readable Activity Serial) format.

      The RAS format is a comma-separated list wrapped in angle brackets, for example: 

       <ClassName,title,YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM,YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM,comment>

      If no comment is set, NIL is used as a placeholder. For example, a HomeActivity titled "Morning Run" with no comment might produce: 

       <HomeActivity,Morning Run,2026/01/01 07:00,2026/01/01 08:00,NIL>
      Returns:
      A single-line RAS representation; commas in field values are not escaped.

    • compareTo

      public int compareTo(Activity other)
      Compares this activity with another activity based on starting time.
      Specified by:
      compareTo in interface Comparable<Activity>
      Parameters:
      other - The other activity to compare with.
      Returns:
      A negative integer, zero, or a positive integer as this activity's start time precedes, equals, or follows the other activity's start time. Equal start times compare as zero even if other fields differ.
